term: equal (the AFP mL=, Leibniz equality at a world)
definition: x mL= y ≡ ∀(λφ. (φ x m→ φ y)): at a world, every property x has there, y has there. Since properties range over all functions Ind → World → Prop, this is equivalent to identity of individuals (Lean `=`): instantiate the property with fun z _ => x = z. Monotheism therefore establishes at most one God-like individual per world; it does not establish existence by itself, but together with C2 it establishes exactly one per world.
